# Pi Agent.nvim

> Pi Agent.nvim is a small Neovim assistant panel that attaches project, file, cursor, visible-buffer, and visual-selection context to coding conversations.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/): Product overview and core workflow.
- [Installation](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/installation): Requirements and lazy.nvim configuration.
- [Getting Started](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/getting-started): Open the panel and ask about files or selections.
- [Authentication](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/authentication): Login behavior and credential boundaries.
- [Chat Buffer](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/usage/chat-buffer): Chat lifecycle and mappings.
- [Editor Context](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/usage/editor-context): Context captured from Neovim.
- [Inline Actions](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/usage/inline-actions): One-off prompts and edits.
- [Commands](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/commands): Complete command reference.
- [Configuration](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/configuration): Setup options and defaults.
- [Troubleshooting](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/troubleshooting): Common runtime, login, and root-detection issues.
- [Contributing](https://sunnybharne.github.io/pi-agent.nvim/contributing): Development and contribution guidance.

## Source

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/sunnybharne/pi-agent.nvim)
